description: Myanmar - Estimated Population Layers is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics", published or maintained by Andy Tatem (World Bank Group). Estimated population layers: Alpha version 2010, 2015 and 2020 estimates of numbers of people per pixel ('ppp') and people per hectare ('pph'), with national totals adjusted to match UN population division estimates ( and remaining unadjusted. Coverage: Myanmar. It has 4 files in GeoTIFF, ZIP. The portal files it under Demographics. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
